scope: Dev-Temp C0/C1/C2 output independent blinded review and adjudication
registration_basis: user supplied three distinct stable aliases after the protocol explicitly required two independent human reviewers and a distinct adjudicator
independence_rules: reviewer_A and reviewer_B must be different human reviewers
reviewer_A and reviewer_B complete their packets independently before comparison
adjudicator must not expose the configuration crosswalk to reviewer_A or reviewer_B
one person must not complete both reviewer packets
completion_rule: 315 A reviews + 315 B reviews + adjudication of every disagreement
